These original controller icons are generated by `tools/fonts/make_pc_button_fonts.py`
using the bundled Nunito SemiBold font. They contain no game or firmware fonts.
Nunito copyright and SIL Open Font License are in [../Nunito/OFL.txt](../Nunito/OFL.txt).
The modified family is named SuperWonders PC Buttons. Generated files are embedded
so existing installations gain prompts without running setup again.
